name: Mandi Bahauddin

queries.query: Pakistan official cadastral map parcel GIS Mandi Bahauddin Punjab land records
queries.result: First-party results identified the Punjab Land Records Authority, the PULSE public cadastral map viewer, the Mandi Bahauddin district administration revenue page, and a municipal Mandi Bahauddin map page. PULSE explicitly lists Mandi Bahauddin among its map areas and exposes a cadastral-map layer, but anonymous parcel feature access was not available in this attempt.

queries.query: پاکستان منڈی بہاؤالدین سرکاری کادستر نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ پنجاب
queries.result: Search results identified the official Punjab land-record service and the Mandi Bahauddin district revenue administration. The Urdu/native-language search did not expose a separate city-bounded public parcel API; the same first-party Punjab/PULSE routes remain the relevant public map procedure.

officialSources.observation: Official Punjab PULSE public viewer says its digital map is based on Mussavie maps and is for indicative visualization only. Its current JavaScript configuration exposes a Punjab cadastral map service and lists a Parcels layer, but the ArcGIS service required a token when queried anonymously.

Official PULSE map-QC page lists Mandi Bahauddin as a supported district/map area and provides parcel, mauza, download, and survey-status routes. Its public hierarchy request returned HTTP 401 Bearer authentication; no token was requested or used.

Official district administration page identifies revenue administration duties including maintenance/updating of land records, tehsil offices, patwari records, and land transactions. This establishes the local district revenue custodian, not an open parcel geometry API.

Official Punjab Land Records Authority portal describes digitized, GIS-linked land records and public land-record services. It establishes the provincial cadastral/land-record authority, not anonymous city-bounded parcel geometry access.
Official municipal page provides an updated Mandi Bahauddin base map, but it does not expose a parcel feature schema or downloadable safe parcel geometry in the bounded inspection.

requests.outcome: Viewer HTML loaded. Current JavaScript/configuration was inspected and identified the public ArcGIS service https://gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk/arcgis/rest/services/VendorMaps/Punjab_Cdastral_Maps/MapServer and its Parcels layer.
ArcGIS service metadata returned Token Required. No token, login, private credential, or bypass was attempted; schema, CRS, and safe native identity therefore remain unverified.

requests.method: GET with bounded envelope and outFields=OBJECTID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3
requests.outcome: Bounded anonymous query returned Token Required. No geometry or parcel row was retained. The envelope was a technical probe, not an exact-point absence test.
Public page route returned Bearer authentication required before hierarchy discovery. No token was requested or used.
Page loaded and exposed parcel download/API route names, but the current parcel route requires a bearer token and was not called with credentials.
District revenue-administration scope was confirmed; no parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.
Municipal base-map page loaded; no safe parcel identity plus full polygon response was exposed.
